featured_reviews.review_text:
Exceptional Experience with Aumkara – Highly Recommended!
We recently completed the interiors of our 1.5 BHK home in Lower Parel with Aumkara, and the entire experience was truly exceptional. After exploring and shortlisting multiple designers, we chose them based on the clarity we felt during our initial discussions — and it turned out to be the best decision we could have made for our home.
What sets Aumkara apart is their beautiful balance of professionalism and warmth. They bring structure and expertise to the process while making you feel completely heard and understood. We genuinely enjoyed being part of the journey — from conceptualization and design discussions to material selection — and learned so much along the way.
Their execution is remarkable. The transition from 3D designs to the final outcome was almost flawless — nearly a 99% match. That level of precision speaks volumes about their commitment to quality.
They are incredibly patient listeners, but what we appreciated even more was their confidence in guiding us. They weren’t afraid to say “no” when certain ideas didn’t align with the overall vision of the space — and in hindsight, that honesty elevated the final result beautifully.
The most special part of the journey was the trust we built. During moments when I felt overwhelmed or unsure, I leaned entirely on their instincts and integrity. Whether it was choosing hardware like door knobs, finalizing the color palette, or designing the Mandir, their selections turned out to be thoughtful, tasteful, and far better than what I would have chosen myself.
From a project management perspective, everything was handled with impressive discipline. Timelines were respected, the budget was carefully managed, and transparency was maintained at every stage. We were consistently informed about design updates and material choices, which gave us complete peace of mind.
Working with Aumkara has been a rewarding and joyful experience. They didn’t just design our house — they helped us create a home we truly love and feel connected to. Thank you Omkar and Alshifa for helping our dream come true.

featured_reviews.name: Jennifer Pinto
featured_reviews.review_text: Hi all, a huge shout out to Prajakta for designing my farm house.  Thank you Prajakta for designing a beautiful home for  us.  She understood me and gave me a design that was exactly the way I wanted.  The home is a mix of old and modern lifestyle. It was nice working with her and happy that we were on the same page most of the time.  All the best to your future endeavours.  God bless you.

featured_reviews.name: Roshan Paul
featured_reviews.review_text:
Adya architect team did a wonderful job in shaping up our new Home.
Prajakta is a keen listener and goes the extra mile to patiently understand the occupants needs and works up the design keeping each family member in mind.
The design layouts, space saving plans and use of natural lighting turned our 1100 sq ft shelter into a comfortable nest.
In particularly liked the way she plays with colors to brighten up the interiors and add brightness post dusk.
Every corner was used intelligently to add value.
What I particularly liked was the way she patiently explained her concepts and fused it with each of our needs . It helped us own the ideas rather than feel thrust upon.
On the rare occasions where touch ups were required the team was always available to help out.
It's great to hear visitors and their WOWs on visiting our place.
We are glad we chose Prajakta to shape our nest.
Me and my family wish Prajaktha and her team the very best.
